replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
This map is way to small in almost everyway. Expanding this map would enhance the gameplay and make the map aesthetically better. Once expanding, you should also add more structures to your build.

Parts of the map are rather flat and could use more elevation. May I also point out that your download must include a level.dat folder to go along with the region folder.

YAML errors
- Line 40 - Unneeded capitol "Efficiency" -> "efficiency"
- Line 94 - Unneeded capitol "Snow-spawn" -> "snow-spawn"
- Line 103 - Unneeded capitol "Ice-spawn" -> "ice-spawn"
